translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol Rom Biynimb Kuyip Minj Tikak.

content: Mam ay sikop. Biynimb yand Yisrel kay Gor ker ma mindpay ak; yip miker gek, nup per aŋgniŋbiyn.
Yand niŋbiyn: chin Gor biynimb nuk mindon aŋgiy, kilis yimb gipay ak pen; gos niŋrep giy ma gipay.
Kiyk Gor biynimb gok kuyip, biynimb suŋ-tep yand aŋgiy dip minim ar ak ma niŋiy, gos key niŋbay rek, low ar ak gon chinup diniŋgamb aŋgiy gi dand amiy, apyap pikpay.
Pen low nuk ayak junj ak Krays nep. Yenen: Gor low ak mindakniŋ, biynimb gok suŋ-tep ma mindpun aŋgiy Krays nup gosimb niŋeniŋgambay, Nop kuyip diy, biynimb suŋ-tep yand aŋgniŋgamb.
Biynimb Gok Nup Aŋgniŋey Kuyip Diniŋgamb
Mosis Yisrel kay kuyip aŋgak, “Low minim ak diy suŋ-tep mindniŋg, low aŋgip aŋgip rek giy mey, kim amniŋgambim aŋgak.”
Pen Gor biynimb Krays nup gosimb niŋiy, suŋ-tep mindeniŋgambay minim ar ak aŋgiy aŋgak, “Semb biyoŋ nimb rek ma am poŋind winiŋgambim;
beŋ nukyaŋ nimb rek ma am poŋind winiŋgambim;
minim kun ak par okok ma mindip. Minim per apim ar anep aŋgak.” Minim aŋgak kun ak mey, Gor nup gosimb niŋiy nuk yip jimñiy mindoniŋgambun aŋgiy, minim per aŋgñimbun ak.
Kun ak, Krays Gor Ñinuk ak mey tikjakip aŋgiy, gos niŋmindiy; Jiysis nep Biyomb yand aŋgiy miseŋ aŋgniŋgambim ak, Gor nimbip biynimb suŋ-tep yand aŋgiy diniŋgamb.
Yenen: Jiysis nup gosimb niŋbun rek, Gor chinup dinimuŋ rek ayip; pen Biyomb chin aŋgiy, miseŋ apun rek chinup pisnep dip.
Wosrey Baybol buk ak, minim tikay aŋgyak, “Biynimb an an nup gosimb niŋniŋgambay gok, Gor nup niŋiy ñawil ma diniŋgambay aŋgyak.”
Jiwda biynimb gok key diy; Jiwda biynimb mer gok key diy ma giniŋgamb. Biyomb nokom mindip rek, biynimb akay akay nup gosimb niŋiy aŋgniŋbay gok direp yimb gip.
Ar kun anep aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Biynimb gok nup aŋgniŋey, kuyip diniŋgamb aŋgyak.”
Pen nimb gunap aŋgniŋgambim, “Biynimb gunap minim tep nup ak dand apey niŋiy rek, nup gosimb niŋiy nup aŋgniŋbinup.
Gor bi minim tep nup aŋgñemb gunap ma yokip ak, yergiy minim tep nup ak niŋjun aŋgniŋgambim.” Ar kun ak Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgyak:

content.text: “Biynimb Gor minim dand opay gok, tep yimb dand opay aŋgyak.”

content: Pen bi Asaya Gor minim tep ak aŋgek, biynimb gunap ma niŋey, nuk Gor nup aŋgak, “Chin minim tep nip ak aŋgon, ma nep dipay aŋgak.”
Gor minim ak timund pik niŋmindiy nep, nup gosimb niŋbay. Minim kun ak, Krays minim tep ak.
Pen Yisrel kay minim kun ak aŋgey ma niŋyak aŋgiy ma aŋgep. Kiyk nind niŋyak ak mey; Baybol buk tikiy aŋgyak, “Minim tep kun ak miñmon okok kind kind, maŋgiysek yimb amimb aŋgyak.”
Pen nimbip tip ak aspiyn: Yisrel biynimb minim kun ak ma niŋyak aŋgiy ma aŋgnimimb; kiyk nind niŋyak. Mosis Gor minim ak tikiy aŋgak:

content.text: “Yand biynimb sakiy sek wikan gunap kuyip diy, direp gen, nimb Yisrel biynimb miluk yapek, chinup rek kun ma gip aŋgiy niŋniŋgambim aŋgak.”

content: Pen bi Asaya miseŋ yimb aŋgiy aŋgak:

content.text: “Gor aŋgip, ‘Biynimb yip ma niŋbay tuŋgoŋ okok, yimb yip ak ñin gunap ma apay ak pen; kisen kuyip diniŋgayn aŋgip’ aŋgak.”

content: Pen Yisrel gipay rek minim ak aŋgiy aŋgak:

content.text: “Gor aŋgip ‘Owim aŋgiy, per ñinan gi gi mer niŋiy kirpiyn.
Kiyk alemb alemb ñiy, gos kiyk key niŋbay rek nep gipay aŋgip’ aŋgak.”
